newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Revived interest raises Bucharest bourse turnover.
newsitem.headline: Revived interest raises Bucharest bourse turnover.

text.p: Turnover on the Bucharest stock exchange went up by 21 million lei to 54.6 million at the week's first session on Tuesday as investor interest picked up.
"There was renewed interest in Azomures, which traded quite well, with more than 3,000 shares changing hands and around 35 million lei in turnover," said a broker.

State fertiliser maker Azomures SA, perceived as a liquid and financially successful company, has been the bourse's star performer this year, accounting for at least 50 percent of almost all trading sessions.
On Tuesday, Azomures closed flat at 10,900 lei.

Investors also took interest in Artrom SA state engineering company and in Sanevit SA, a private syringe maker, which traded around 1,000 shares each. Both marked time at 2,100 and 9,000 respectively.
The other privately held traded stock, construction company Impact SA, which joined the bourse a session ago, failed to arouse buying interest.
"Demand was higher than supply for Impact, but the overall feeling is that investors are still probing into this company," a trader said.
Impact closed a slight 200 lei stronger at 9,000.
Brokers said they expected modest volumes at the second weekly session on Thursday. Little change was forecast despite presidential polls scheduled for Sunday.

Two unofficial value-weighted indices -- the VAB, computed by Vanguard SA securities, and the BIG, compiled by Bucharest Investment Group rose from the previous session by 1.5 percent and respectively 1.61 percent.
